title: FIELD/FIELDLIST writer allocation rollback and retry
scope: Strengthen the generated whole-operation ASCII/Binary FIELD and FIELDLIST transaction control to compare the caller's complete modeled test profile after failures and verify the supported typed payload after clean same-codec retry.

allocationSweep.fieldAscii: 12/12 failures injected; destination and modeled caller state preserved; same-codec retry and typed readback passed.
allocationSweep.fieldListAscii: 4/4 failures injected; destination and modeled caller state preserved; same-codec retry and typed readback passed.
allocationSweep.fieldBinary: 11/11 failures injected; destination and modeled caller state preserved; same-codec retry and typed readback passed.
allocationSweep.fieldListBinary: 4/4 failures injected; destination and modeled caller state preserved; same-codec retry and typed readback passed.

validation.readback: FIELD handle/owner/common metadata, extData/appData counts, evaluator and expression, CadValue format/data type/size/unit, variant code/type/double value, formatted value string/length, child/object handle vectors, and child-value count match the generated profile. FIELDLIST handle/owner/common metadata, extData/appData counts, unknown field and single FIELD member handle match.

limitations: Generated writer transaction and typed readback only; this does not establish source-producer interoperability or support claims.
The FIELDLIST member and object owner are checked, but visibility and recursive reachability from a named dictionary root are not qualified here.
FIELD expression evaluation, native consumer display, and unsupported FIELD token preservation remain open.
fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture was added; the existing test generates output in scratch storage.
